scope: Create Invoice from Suppliers; excludes Credit Notes, Prepayments and Card Purchases
release_checks: Compile and exercise the functions in a Zoho test environment; Node tests emulate control flow and do not validate Deluge compilation or actual CRM API behavior.
Verify crm_oauth_connection, function caller permissions, field read/write access and OAuth REST access from the embedded widget. Do not expose helpers as public API-key endpoints.
Create fields before functions, preserve the existing globally unique Supplier_Invoices.Name and verify all three Registration_Key uniqueness constraints before enabling the widget.
Compare rebuildsuppliersettlementtotals with the latest published source before updating. The sole intended change excludes Registration_Key invoices in Pending registration from totals.
Review invoice workflows, blueprints and external automations. Creation must not trigger payments or accounting posting, and incomplete registrations must not be processed automatically.
Test actual file upload and atomic Invoice_File insertion; read back the file and reject any workflow changes to invoice amounts or associations.
Test browser localStorage and Web Locks inside the Zoho widget, including two tabs, reload, lost responses and failed refresh.
Publish the widget only after these backend dependencies pass. The existing dist/AccountingManager.zip was not rebuilt by this change.

invariants.states: Pending: invoice exists but children are incomplete; Ready: children confirmed and totals can be rebuilt; Complete: registration and totals confirmed.
invariants.payments: Received with Amount_Paid=0; this endpoint never creates payment records.
invariants.allocations: Active allocations sum to Total_Payable_Amount, including Reimbursable_Expense; multiple invoices per settlement remain possible.
invariants.lines: Service lines preserve informational service purchase costs and are not the source of invoice totals.
invariants.retry: Reuse the original operationKey and exact requestJson. Never generate another key after an ambiguous response. Keep registration fields and records when restoring a previous widget build.
invariants.direct_crm_inserts: Settlement validation is mandatory in the new endpoint. Other integrations and direct CRM inserts still require a separate module-level validation review; this change does not make the CRM lookup globally mandatory.

remaining_activation.action: Upload dist/AccountingManager.zip to the existing AccountingManager widget in Zoho CRM, then validate the Suppliers Create Invoice flow in the embedded widget.
